baselineAudit.notes: Static triage only. 60/244 items in the third rewrite tranche have been classified for substantive revision and qualified educator review; no clinical approval or content change was recorded.

commonFindings: All 20 reuse the same generic reassessment stem and one of four generic answer/rationale families; the format remains single-response for every item in this audited range.
Named cardiovascular/perfusion topics are paired with unrelated or nonspecific findings rather than topic-defining assessment, diagnostic or timeline evidence.
Several records have age/context mismatch or omit the history needed to make the named diagnosis plausible; newborn/child cases use adult-like or non-age-specific cues.

Correct-answer option families alternate between generic escalation, generic organ-compromise recognition, generic communication and generic effectiveness statements; the rationale repeats a topic label plus boilerplate.
Blueprint/CJMM alignment is weak: several options assess generic escalation or effectiveness regardless of the assigned clinical judgment function.
